verdict: No additional concrete blocker found in the reviewed adapter delta and fourteen prepared contracts.
original_failure_chain: shared_preferences 2.5.5 _setValue changes _preferenceCache before returning the platform setValue Future; false or a thrown error does not restore the previous cache.

The b721 PreferencesMemoryStore readRound/readStats return getString directly. Controller _writeInitial/_commit/_saveStats compare this readback with the proposed JSON after a failed write, so the unchanged optimistic cache can impersonate a confirmed platform commit.
reviewed_changes: Only readRound/readStats and their private _readConfirmed helper change. Each read awaits preferences.reload before getString. A reload error escapes; no catch, default, cached fallback or per-instance uncertainty flag can bypass it.
The same SharedPreferences singleton reached through a newly constructed adapter is subject to a new successful reload. No prior failed write or failed reload is rehabilitated by merely reopening.
The unchanged controller still permits commit-then-error recovery only when the subsequent read returns the proposed JSON; the patched adapter obtains that read after successful platform refresh.

Controller _commit leaves the currently exposed round unchanged and keeps uncertainty when write/reload fails. A later successful read can reconcile an actually committed round. Stats failures do not update _stats/_best through the failed _saveStats path.

Initial unreadable statistics retain the existing controller behavior: _statsWritable becomes false and those values are not overwritten. A failed round read aborts open, rather than creating an empty default.
Round/Stats keys, owner validation, unowned historical lumo_memory_v2 exclusion, catalog, write methods, owner-serial queue, rules, reward ID, and profile guards are unchanged.

prepared_tests.execution_status: NOT_EXECUTED; actual Flutter CI is required
prepared_tests.backend: Real SharedPreferences legacy cache plus a controlled InMemorySharedPreferencesStore platform boundary; no MemoryStore mock.
prepared_tests.checked_api: Exact host pubspec.lock pins shared_preferences 2.5.5 and direct-dev shared_preferences_platform_interface 2.4.2. The independently read upstream interface permits the subclass and matches getAll/setValue/persisted access signatures.
groups: Rejected initial round cannot become acknowledged solely through cache.
Round false-before-commit and throw-before-commit keep original state.
Round and Stats false/throw, repeated reload errors, a second store and a fresh controller over the identical singleton cannot read poisoned cache as platform data.
Actual round commit followed by error is recovered; actual commit plus failed reload remains hidden until later successful recovery.
Failed Stats commit leaves the same result ID unresolved for explicit retry; actual Stats commit followed by error permits the confirmed finish without another award.
Profile revoked before I/O, during reload and during an already accepted write cannot expose a stale-owner result or mutate the other owner's key.
prepared_tests.timing_review: Gate outcomes are attached before release, entered waits are bounded, gate release occurs in finally, and test outcomes are awaited. Source review only; this is not an executed race result.

limitations: No Flutter, Dart, test, application, emulator or physical-device execution by this reviewer.
The fourteen test cases are declarations, not fourteen PASS results.
Platform-backend tests establish cache/platform contract behavior; they are not a physical storage fsync, Android restart or device performance measurement.
The focused review does not certify unrelated SharedPreferences callers or cross-isolate external writers.
